title: Archive Resolved Signal phase in fix_signal.skill.md always fails at in_progress status
description: archive_signal returned error 'cannot archive a1000122-0614-4000-8000-000000000122 — status is in_progress (must be resolved or superseded)'. The fix_signal workflow only advances signals to in_progress; it never resolves them. The Archive Resolved Signal phase will always fail in fix_signal, generating a spurious SkillImprovement signal on every run.
proposed_resolution: Remove the Archive Resolved Signal phase from fix_signal.skill.md. Signal archiving belongs in the run skill post-resolution hook, not in fix_signal which only marks signals as picked up.
